title: Algebraic implicitization techniques in the graphical models program
summary: Many aspects of daily life now rely on technology driven by advanced techniques for analyzing multivariate data. Graphical models provide the general framework within which much of these analyses take place. However, different data types require different graphical models, with each requiring its own basic mathematical theory to guide sound statistical inference. Developing this theory for a family of graphical models requires solutions to fundamental questions, where emerging mathematical approaches are utilizing what can collectively be called algebraic implicitization techniques.
